svg.text: Training pipeline: recorded episodes -> frozen V-JEPA latent -> Q, R, D
Everything runs from simulation/ (python -m world_model.<file>). One run folder per dataset under data/, the trained models in attempts/combined/models/.
1a collect_full.py -> data/full_test1
frozen SAC on its layout, cube start jittered ±3 cm
4 cases: normal, forced drop at 15/50/75 % + recovery
2 views: empty table, clutter twin (same actions)
16 / 4 / 6 scenes · 30,642 states
needs data/rl_baseline_v1 (config, layout, sac_best.zip)
1b collect_obstacles.py -> data/obstacles_test1
normal_empty: SAC on the empty table
replay_obstacles: same actions, 1-3 corridor obstacles
scripted_obstacles: scripted route around them
14 / 4 / 6 scenes · 10,103 states · the data R learns from
test scenes = controller/control_clutter benchmark
1c data_collection.collect + prepare_episodes.py
configs/full_mix.yml: success .4 scripted .2 drop .1
collide .15 random .15, 1-3 obstacles, 120 episodes
prepare_episodes: episode folders -> manifest
-> data/episodes_test1 · 17,265 states
adds fingers closed on nothing, collisions, random motion
each run: manifest.json (states: p (20), cube xyz, held, reward components, frame history · rollouts: state indices + actions) + observations/*.jpg
2 encode.py (V-JEPA 2 ViT-L, frozen, fp16, CUDA) -> <run>/features/latents.npy, pca.npz, meta.json
clip = the last 16 static frames of a state -> 8 x 16 x 16 tokens of 1024
mean over the 8 time slices -> 16x16 grid -> 2x2 average pool -> 8x8 cells -> PCA 1024 -> 16 per cell
z = 8 * 8 * 16 = 1024 numbers that keep where things are (the cube is ~10 px, the token mean lost it)
PCA basis fitted on 300 full_test1 clips; the other two runs reuse it with --pca (same latent space) · 0.16 s per state
3 merge_runs.py -> data/combined_test1 (58,010 states)
keys prefixed by run, frames symlinked, latents concatenated, one manifest
4a train.py readout -> Q(z, p)
in [z, p] = 1044 -> cube xyz (3) + held logit
MLP 128 wide · loss: MSE(xyz, normalised) + BCE(held)
also readout_p: the same from p alone (blind control)
val: xyz MAE 1.5 / 2.9 / 0.45 cm, held F1 0.96
trained first: dynamics needs the frozen Q
4b train.py reward -> R(z, p) (penalty head)
in [z, p] -> proximity (-1..0), collision logit,
table-hit logit · loss: MSE + BCE + BCE
targets = the recorded unweighted reward components
(nonzero only in the obstacle data)
val: collision AUC 0.995 real, 0.99 imagined at 8 steps
4c train.py dynamics -> D(z, p, a)
SplitDynamicsZ: robot head (z, p, a) -> p + d
visual head (z, p, a, p') -> z + d · widths 128 / 512
windows of 8 actions, rolled out recursively
loss: MSE(z) + MSE(p) + 1.0 * task term
task term: frozen Q must read the recorded cube on imagined states
frozen Q (same tag, same normalisation)
5 eval_reward.py
R scored on real latents and on latents D imagined over 1 / 4 / 8 steps
from the recorded actions (what the planner sees) · reports/reward_<split>.json
-> controller/control_pipeline.py
loads attempts/combined/models/{readout,reward,dynamics}.pt,
features/pca.npz + meta.json (the online encoder) and rl_baseline_v1/models/sac_best.zip
bash world_model/run_combined.sh does steps 3, 4a-c and 5. Solid arrows = data, dashed = a frozen model used in a loss. Numbers from data/combined_test1 (CHANGES_FROM_M2.md).
